name: digidollar
title: DigiDollar
summary: DigiByte's stablecoin: its price, supply and health from this arcade's DigiByte Core, and minting from your own wallet (test chains).

ddstats.help: DigiDollar on this arcade's DigiByte: the oracle's price, the supply and how well it is backed.

ddcollateral.help:
The DGB a mint of this many dollars locks, for this long.

ddcollateral <dollars> [tier]   tier 0 is one hour, 1 thirty days, up to 9 for ten years

ddmint.help:
Mint DigiDollars from your own DGB: it stays locked in a vault until the tier's time is up.

ddmint <dollars> [tier]   your wallet shows the transaction and signs it. Test chains only for now.
